HERO_HEADLINE: A finance app that keeps your data yours
HERO_SUBHEAD: Local-first, no server storage, optional encryption, and backup to a Google Drive file you control. Privacy isn't a setting — it's the architecture.
PROBLEM_HEADLINE: Most finance apps are built to collect your data
PROBLEM_BODY:
Free apps are rarely free — they monetise your financial data through ads, offers, or resale. Even paid apps usually store everything on their own servers, where it's a target.

FincWin is built the other way. Your data lives on your device, never on our servers, and you choose if and where it's backed up.
CAPABILITIES:
• ✓Local-first — data lives in your browser, not our cloud.
  • ✓No server storage — FincWin keeps no copy of your finances.
  • ✓Optional encryption — lock your data behind a PIN.
  • ✓Your-own-Drive backup — you own the backup file.

FAQ_ITEMS:
Where is my financial data stored?

On your device, in your browser. FincWin keeps no copy on any server. Backup is optional and goes to your own Google Drive.

Do you sell or use my data?

No. There are no ads and no data resale. The app is funded by Pro subscriptions, not your data.

Can I lock the app?

Yes — optional encryption lets you protect your data behind a PIN.
